title: Xmas Spirit
description: Expanded Christmas tweaks for Better than Adventure that add humorously festive paintings, baked goods, and various festive trinkets!
body:
![Snowy Header](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/770086aef32f4f7278830c6412157416bb217a69.png)

This asset pack for the Beta 1.7.3 fork, [Better than Adventure!](https://www.betterthanadventure.net/), expands the Chistmas jolly with expanded texture tweaks to compliment those in BTA, including but not limited to: humorously festive paintings, Christmas baked goods, and ornamental lanterns!

Here's a showcase of just a few of the things this asset pack includes!

![Some tweaked blocks for the Christmas season](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ed7d68cddf09ca43ff66446d23b7abd17a610d32.png)

# Installation
This asset pack is made for [Better than Adventure!](https://www.betterthanadventure.net/) as mentioned above and is unlikely to work at all on plain **Beta 1.7.3!**

Download this asset pack and put it in the `texturepacks` folder found within your Better than Adventure instance. The ingame Texture Packs option has a button to open this folder if you don't know where to find it.

# Where is all the Christmas joy?
This asset pack is specifically made to enable during the Christmas season **with** the rest of the BTA Christmas tweaks, so you may have to wait until next year, _but it's worth the wait!_ :)
